title: Multi-agent Auditory Scene Analysis: Improved Localization Speed and Robustness by Multi-beamformed Speech Quality Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.00538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A real-time auditory scene analyzer (ASA) aims to carry out the tasks of locating, separating and classifying the sound sources present in a given acoustic environment. Recently, an effort has been made into modelling an ASA as a multi-agent system, with each one of its agents performing one of the aforementioned tasks and communicating their results to the rest of their peer agents. These communication routes are used as feedback loops to fix local errors at a global level, providing robustness while reducing local complexity. An example of the benefits of this approach is the optimization of speech quality by correcting in real-time the estimated location of the speech source of interest. However, their optimization speed has been shown to be considerably slow. translated_title: 多智能体听觉场景分析：通过多波束成形语音质量反馈提升定位速度与鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 实时听觉场景分析器（ASA）旨在对给定声学环境中存在的声源执行定位、分离和分类任务。最近，有研究致力于将ASA建模为多智能体系统，其中每个智能体执行上述任务之一，并将其结果传达给其余的同伴智能体。这些通信路线被用作反馈回路，在全局层面修复局部错误，在提供鲁棒性的同时降低了局部复杂性。这种方法优势的一个例子是，通过实时校正感兴趣语音源的估计位置来优化语音质量。然而，其优化速度已被证明相当缓慢。一个可能的原因是它仅依赖一系列单一的质量估计（由无参考质量估计器模型提供），而这些估计彼此之间存在较大波动……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出在多智能体听觉场景分析系统中引入多波束成形语音质量反馈机制，显著提升了语音源定位的速度与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper improves localization speed and robustness in multi-agent auditory scene analysis by introducing a multi-beamformed speech quality feedback mechanism.
